notes: Curated subscription and allowance announcements, transcribed verbatim into the feed.
Every entry needs provider, summary and an https source_url the reader can check.
Optional: model, category (default subscription), previous/current rate blocks,
observed_at (default: generation time), effective_at, confidence (default curated),
provenance, conditions. Never invent a change: if the effective date or the new
allowance cannot be established from the source, leave it out and say so in conditions.
See curated.example.json for the entry shape.
